title: Event Management Platform
description: Developed a full-stack event platform for event registration and ticket purchasing. Integrated secure payments via Checkout.com API. Built a credit-based networking system for attendee connections. Implemented Plus and Premier subscription plans with enhanced features. Enabled admin and user-hosted events with customizable ticket pricing. Added coupon and discount systems for promotions.

title: Ai Stories
description: Built an AI-driven system that converts user prompts into complete videos automatically. Used LLMs to generate structured story scripts from prompts. Generated voice narration and used Whisper for timestamp-based media synchronization. Created visuals using WAN 2.2 (video) and MiniMax, DeepInfra, Seedream, and Nano Banana . Implemented automated subtitles with animations and styling. Composed final videos by merging audio, visuals, and subtitles using FFmpeg on RunPod.

title: Amfi
description: AMFI AI  is a crypto coin and Web3 platform website. It promotes its own cryptocurrency token called AMFI (Automated Meta Finance). The project says it combines:  AI (Artificial Intelligence) for trading bots and market analysis DeFi (Decentralized Finance) for staking and crypto finance tools Metaverse/Web3 features like virtual services and digital assets

title: Doctor Appointment
description: Consultos Doctors Landing Page  is a modern healthcare and doctor consultation landing page website. It is designed for users to easily connect with doctors online and book medical consultations.  Main features shown on the website include:  Online doctor appointments Video and virtual consultations Search doctors by specialty Healthcare services information Doctor profiles and specialties Simple and user-friendly medical platform UI
